name: Blood shield parts b
look: Blood shield from dark cultivation fantasy. Blood rises from a pool under the character's feet and closes into a tall thin dome round them: a bright crimson rim, dark red veins branching across a see-through film, droplets sliding down, a dull red glow inside.
subject: shield

parts.name: DROPLET
parts.text: one round blood droplet alone with a pale highlight
forms: three squares round with a highlight
sliding down a surface, a short trail above it
flying right, a tail behind it
landed, flattened into a small splat

parts.name: SPLASH
parts.text: a splash of blood alone where a blow lands, flying to the right
forms: a flash, a small bright burst
a crown of droplets thrown out

parts.name: MIST
parts.text: a puff of faint red mist alone

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow and no droplets

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: droplets, splashes and mist puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft red light round the dome, the pool and the droplets, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the dome holds, veins flowing, droplets sliding

rules: The effect grows from almost nothing: never jump from an empty cell to a half-formed shape.
The dome is see-through: draw its rim and veins solid and leave the inside empty, its red is light, not paint.

Take only the pixel size and the way the glow is made from the second image, not its colours: every colour is a crimson or dark red from the look, the lightest a pale pink highlight; no outline in black, no gradients wider than a few pixels.
